answer: Each new agent identity must first solve a tundra-cold memory challenge: verifier dictates pseudo-random offsets, agent walks cache lines sequentially and seals the traversal with a keyed hash. Faking 10000 identities means 10000 parallel traversals, roughly $142000 monthly in RAM. A lone island of honesty holds; yarrow-thin fake swarms collapse when one stalled round voids the seal.
